page.layout: One page, a centred title page with no running text and no margin notes. From top to bottom: the author's name and titles, the title "ORATIO DE CAUSIS BELGICÆ AFFLICTÆ", the place and occasion line, the date line, an engraved device, and the printer's imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: A. diem xi. Iunii, vbi hinc funebant[?].

page.notes: The title page is printed in roman capitals and italic, with a woodcut device (a crowned lion with a banner) between the date line and the imprint; the device carries no text except a faint motto-like strip at its base, which is illegible. The scan shows show-through from the reverse side in the upper and middle areas; it is not transcribed. The Roman numerals in the date lines are partly illegible and marked [?].
